subject: Request: Accelerator promotion policy carveout for Seed Signal
messages:
From: Aubrey Chen <aubrey@seedsignal.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: incubator@seedsignal.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot promo request — Seed Signal accelerator

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the throughput and billing insights. We're putting together the package for the upcoming cohort and I wanted to check whether Redwood can support a promotional carveout beyond the standard accelerator credit cap.

Context: Seed Signal is running a 12-team cohort starting Aug 2. Typical usage per team is spiky (training + inference bursts), and we'd like to offer each team an onboarding stipend so they can build without immediate bill concerns. Our ask: a one-time pool of $7,500 in hosted credits + a 10% committed capacity discount for the first 3 months while teams ramp. I know standard promo limits are lower — hoping you can advise options for an exception.

Attached is our onboarding SOW and a high-level cohort size estimate. Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Attachments: [SeedSignal_Onboarding_SOW.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

Best,
Aubrey Chen
Program Director | Seed Signal
Aubrey@seedsignal.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aubrey Chen <aubrey@seedsignal.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot promo request — Seed Signal accelerator

Hi Aubrey — thanks for the SOW and the cohort details. Really appreciate the clarity on spike patterns; that helps a lot.

Short answers up front: we can often support larger onboarding pools for strategic partners like Seed Signal, but anything above our standard accelerator cap requires an approved promotional carveout and a short commercial amendment (MPA addendum). Two things I need from you to move this quickly:

- Final cohort count (heads) and an expected per-team monthly token estimate (p50/p95) so we size reserved capacity.
- Confirmation whether the $7.5k is intended as a single pooled credit for the cohort or as per-team allotments.

Proposed commercial starting point (subject to approval):
- One-time pooled credit: $5,000 (as an immediate promo)
- Additional $2,500 conditional on a 3-month committed minimum (we'd apply credits pro rata against committed usage)
- 10% discount on committed reserved capacity for first 3 months (requires a 3-month committed billing schedule)

I've attached a redline of our promo policy showing the clause we'd need to amend. Ben is cc'd to propose the committed capacity schedule and to work with legal on contractual language. If this sounds reasonable I can route for a fast-track approval.

Attachments: [promo_policy_redline.docx (DOCX, 24KB)]

Thanks — available for a 20-minute sync tomorrow afternoon if helpful.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic GTM | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
(415) 555-0134

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aubrey Chen <aubrey@seedsignal.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot promo request — Seed Signal accelerator

Thanks Aubrey / Kimberly. Based on the cohort profile Kimberly shared, here is a workable commercial structure we can propose to legal/finance for fast-track approval:

- Immediate onboarding promo: $5,000 pooled credits (applies to hosted API calls / embeddings).
- Performance trigger: additional $2,500 credit unlocked if Seed Signal meets a 3-month committed baseline of 4 v100-equivalent hours/day average across the cohort (measured at p50 usage).
- Pricing: 10% discount on reserved capacity rates for months 1–3 following cohort start; discount drops to standard reserved pricing thereafter.
- Billing: Upfront invoice for the committed capacity portion, applied as a discount across monthly invoices.

I've attached a simple commitment schedule to illustrate how the credits and discounts apply across months and how they'd be invoiced. If legal/finance want to preserve margins, we can tighten the trigger to p70 instead of p50.

Attachments: [AMP-commitment-schedule.xlsx (XLSX, 32KB)]

Kimberly — can you route to Grace for approval to exceed the standard promo cap? If she signs off we'll push the amendment to contracts and get a DocuSign ready for Aubrey.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Partner Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Aubrey Chen <aubrey@seedsignal.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot promo request — Seed Signal accelerator (approval)

Thanks team — I reviewed Ben's proposed structure and the promo redline. Given the strategic nature of Seed Signal (cohort visibility, potential channel adoption), I approve a one-time pooled onboarding credit of $7,500 with the conditional $2,500 unlock tied to the 3-month committed baseline as outlined. Legal should prepare an MPA addendum that:

- Adds the one-time $7,500 promo pool and the conditional $2,500 unlock clause.
- Specifies measurement window and p-value (use p70 to be conservative).
- Includes a clause that reserved capacity discounts apply only to billed reserved usage and do not stack with other promotional discounts.

Contracts: please route the addendum for signature and copy finance for invoicing guidance. I've attached a short approval memo for the file.

Attachments: [approval-memo.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Pilot promo request — Seed Signal accelerator (approval)

This is great news — thank you Grace, Kimberly, Ben. Seed Signal accepts the one-time $7,500 pool and the conditional $2,500 unlock with the p70 measurement window. A few quick asks to complete:

1) Please send the MPA addendum and SOW via DocuSign so our legal/procurement can sign.
2) We'll need an invoice for the committed capacity portion (if there's an upfront invoice required per your billing note). Please copy finance@seedsignal.com.
3) Can you confirm when the credits will appear in the account once the DocuSign is completed? We want to ensure teams can access credits before Aug 2 start.

If you can get the DocuSign link and invoice by EOD Wednesday (7/21) we'll circulate internally and return signed quickly. Happy to jump on a 15-minute call if any of the contract language needs clarification.

Thanks again — excited to launch the cohort with Redwood.

Best,
Aubrey Chen
Program Director | Seed Signal
aubrey@seedsignal.com
